objectTypes.title: Product
objectTypes.meaning: The whole. The centre to start from.

objectTypes.title: Concept
objectTypes.meaning: A kind of thing the product manages: a task, a member, a run.

objectTypes.title: Role
objectTypes.meaning: What a person or agent is allowed to be, in an organization or towards one thing.

objectTypes.title: Function
objectTypes.meaning: One named action the permission rules decide.

objectTypes.title: Module
objectTypes.meaning: A vertical slice of the product with its own screens, rules and data.

objectTypes.title: Flow
objectTypes.meaning: A sequence that crosses modules to produce an outcome.

objectTypes.title: Step
objectTypes.meaning: One stage of a flow, taking place in one module.

objectTypes.title: Requirement
objectTypes.meaning: A numbered group of testable statements in a specification.

objectTypes.title: Screen
objectTypes.meaning: A page or a named part of one.

relationTypes.meaning: Containment. The target cannot be removed without the source.
A role exists in relation to this thing.
Who can be given the role.
The permission rules allow it by default.
The actions that exist for this thing.
The module where a step takes place.
A flow has at least one step here.
A date, a duration or an order attached to work.
Ownership of code and data by a module.
Where the records of a concept live.
The module that owns a concept's storage.
A concept whose storage refers to another's.
A source file imports a table.
Code of one module uses data of another.
The specification that states what this must do.
A requirement belongs to one specification.

tiers.title: Work
tiers.summary: What people and agents are here to do.

tiers.title: The agent loop
tiers.summary: An agent works, a person accepts. What makes Taff different.

tiers.title: Control and trust
tiers.summary: Who may act, and proof of what happened.

tiers.title: Time and money on work
tiers.summary: Attributes of work: when, in what order, for how much.

tiers.title: Context
tiers.summary: Enriches work. Work survives without it.

tiers.title: Views, not things
tiers.summary: Recomputed on read. Nothing is stored.

rules: Every object in M has a type in O, and every relation joins only the types O allows.
A concept's tier is a judgement about purpose; inside a tier the order is the number of tables that cannot exist without it.
Every table belongs to exactly one concept and one module.
Every route, tool, core file, page, permission function and specification belongs to one module.
A relation marked derived is computed from others and is never edited by hand.
A view reads M and never changes it.

objects.title: Taff
objects.summary: People and agents working on the same tasks, with a person approving agent output.

objects.title: System
objects.summary: One installation of Taff. Holds users and organizations.

objects.title: User
objects.summary: A person who can sign in. May carry the system administrator flag.

objects.title: Group of organizations
objects.summary: Not modelled. Nothing groups several organizations.

objects.title: Organization
objects.summary: Called workspace in code. The boundary of data and permission.

objects.title: Member
objects.summary: A user or an agent inside one organization, with one role there.

objects.title: Agent
objects.summary: A member of kind agent, with a supervisor and a review policy.

objects.title: Project
objects.summary: Flat. Stage, person in charge, saved progress, client company.

objects.title: Sub-project or phase
objects.summary: Not modelled. A project has no parent and no children.

objects.title: Task
objects.summary: A unit of work with an owner and an optional worker. May sit directly in the organization.

objects.title: Subtask
objects.summary: A task whose parent is another task.

objects.title: Comment
objects.summary: What someone said on a task.

objects.title: Acceptance criterion
objects.summary: A task requirement that a human reviewer can check.

objects.title: Time entry
objects.summary: A person records minutes of work on a task for one workspace-local day.

objects.title: Hourly rate
objects.summary: An hourly rate in one currency, starting on a civil date.

objects.title: Run
objects.summary: One attempt by an agent to do a task.

objects.title: Run event
objects.summary: A step the agent took, with its cost and duration.

objects.title: Deliverable
objects.summary: What the run produced, kept for review.

objects.title: Review decision
objects.summary: A person's approval or request for changes, with the checklist.

objects.title: Permission request
objects.summary: An agent asks to use a capability; a person allows or denies it.

objects.title: Suggestion
objects.summary: A change an agent proposes; a person applies or undoes it.

objects.title: Organization role
objects.summary: Admin, member or guest. The first input of every permission check.

objects.title: Capability
objects.summary: What an agent may do: allow, ask or deny, per kind of action.

objects.title: Token
objects.summary: How an outside client acts as an agent, with scopes per organization.

objects.title: Tool call
objects.summary: One MCP call and how it ended.

objects.title: Audit record
objects.summary: Who did what to which thing. Also drives live refresh.

objects.title: Due date
objects.summary: The deadline, an instant.

objects.title: Scheduled block
objects.summary: A time block on the calendar, with optional repeat.

objects.title: Plan
objects.summary: A start day and a number of days. The bar on the Gantt.

objects.title: Dependency
objects.summary: This cannot start or finish before that.

objects.title: Task link
objects.summary: A related or duplicate connection between tasks.

objects.title: Milestone
objects.summary: A named date on a project.

objects.title: Contract
objects.summary: The agreed amount and currency.

objects.title: Payment
objects.summary: Money received. Append-only.

objects.title: Project budget
objects.summary: An amount in currency micros for comparison with actual costs.

objects.title: Project margin
objects.summary: Payments received minus actual costs in the same currency.

objects.title: Project health update
objects.summary: An append-only health statement from the project lead or an admin.

objects.title: Company
objects.summary: A client or partner.

objects.title: Contact
objects.summary: A person outside the organization.

objects.title: Stakeholder role
objects.summary: What a contact is to a company, a project or a task.

objects.title: Mind-map node
objects.summary: An idea on the mind map, with links to others.

objects.title: Evidence source
objects.summary: Where a mind-map node's claim comes from.

objects.title: Label
objects.summary: Free tags on a task. Six of them name the sectors.

objects.title: Inbox item
objects.summary: Something that needs a person: a mention, a blocked agent, a review.

objects.title: Notification setting
objects.summary: What a person wants to be told, and when.

objects.title: Daily digest
objects.summary: A person's own daily summary.

objects.title: Audience
objects.summary: Which recipients get the summary of which projects.

objects.title: Shareholder summary
objects.summary: A stored snapshot of project progress, as text and image.

objects.title: Share link
objects.summary: An expiring link to one summary.

objects.title: Exported image
objects.summary: A watermarked PNG of a view. Not stored; each export is audited.

objects.title: Board, list and Today
objects.summary: The same tasks, sorted and filtered.

objects.title: Gantt model
objects.summary: Spans, critical path, forecast and risk, computed from plans and dependencies.

objects.title: Task completion and risk
objects.summary: Progress computed from leaf tasks; the project's risk level.

objects.title: Relations graph
objects.summary: People, agents, tasks, projects, companies and contacts as one graph.

objects.title: Sectors
objects.summary: Tasks regrouped by six labels.

objects.title: AI brief
objects.summary: A daily reading of risk, finance and what needs a person.

objects.title: Admin
objects.summary: Everything in the organization: members, projects, finance, tokens, agents, summaries, audit.

objects.title: Member
objects.summary: Reads tasks, projects, finance and contacts. Creates tasks and comments. Edits what they own.

objects.title: Guest
objects.summary: Reads tasks, the relations graph and the mind map. No finance, no contacts, no writing.

objects.title: Agent
objects.summary: A member of kind agent. Limited by token scopes, its capabilities and temporary grants; finished work waits for a person.

objects.title: System administrator
objects.summary: A flag on the user. Admin membership in every organization.

objects.title: Person in charge
objects.summary: May change the project's stage.

objects.title: Owner
objects.summary: A person. Edits, assigns, plans and approves.

objects.title: Worker
objects.summary: A person or an agent. Does the work; cannot mark it done.

objects.title: Supervisor
objects.summary: Approves the agent's work and decides its requests.

objects.title: Stakeholder
objects.summary: An outside person with a named role on the project.

objects.title: Tasks
objects.summary: Create, edit, assign, comment and change status; subtasks; labels; Quick Add; search; Today.

objects.title: Projects and finance
objects.summary: Project profile, stage, person in charge, contract amount and payments.

objects.title: Planning (Gantt)
objects.summary: Start and duration per task, milestones and dependencies. Computes the critical path, forecast and project risk on read.

objects.title: Calendar
objects.summary: Time blocks for tasks, with recurrence, and the unscheduled tray.

objects.title: Agents, runs and review
objects.summary: An agent works a task as a run, records events and deliverables, and waits for a person to approve.

objects.title: Access: tokens, OAuth and MCP
objects.summary: How an outside agent connects: OAuth approval, token scopes per organization, the permission function and the call log.

objects.title: Inbox and notifications
objects.summary: Mentions, blocked agents and reviews; preferences; the personal daily digest.

objects.title: AI brief, Ask and suggestions
objects.summary: Rule-based daily brief and answers, an optional model path per organization, and suggestions a person applies or undoes.

objects.title: Shareholder summaries
objects.summary: A daily project summary per audience, as text and image, with expiring share links.

objects.title: Exported view images
objects.summary: Project, timeline, week, month, mind and relations as a watermarked PNG. Images are not stored.

objects.title: Companies and contacts
objects.summary: Client and partner companies, people, and their roles on a company, project or task.

objects.title: Relations graph
objects.summary: One picture of people, agents, tasks, projects, companies and contacts. A read model that stores nothing.

objects.title: Mind map
objects.summary: Layered nodes with evidence sources; a node can link to a task.

objects.title: Sectors (operation template)
objects.summary: Regroups tasks by six sector labels. A view over task labels; nothing is stored.

objects.title: Organizations and members
objects.summary: Create, archive and restore an organization; invite people; set roles; the login default.

objects.title: Sign-in and profile
objects.summary: Email, username, phone and SMS sign-in; locale and time zone.

objects.title: Audit and realtime
objects.summary: Every write records who did what; a database notification tells open browsers what to refresh.

objects.title: Kernel
objects.summary: createCore wires every module and still holds the task, member and organization operations. Also migrations, seeds and health.

objects.title: CN-3 Project management after phone filters
A person hands work to an agent and approves it
Task
objects.summary: A person creates a task and sets an agent as worker.

objects.title: Run
objects.summary: The agent starts a run; events and deliverables are recorded.

objects.title: Permission
objects.summary: Each step is checked against scopes and capabilities. An “ask” capability pauses the run.

objects.title: Inbox
objects.summary: The request, and later the finished work, reach the supervisor's inbox.

objects.title: Review
objects.summary: The owner or supervisor approves or asks for changes in the review workspace.

objects.title: Done
objects.summary: Only a person moves the task to done.

objects.title: A plan becomes a risk line and a report
Tasks
objects.summary: Status, due dates and subtasks.

objects.title: Plan
objects.summary: Start, duration, milestones and dependencies; the model computes critical path, forecast and risk.

objects.title: Brief
objects.summary: The AI brief reports risk and finance per project.

objects.title: Summary
objects.summary: The shareholder summary reuses the same model.

objects.title: Image
objects.summary: The timeline exports as a watermarked PNG.

objects.title: Project
objects.summary: Progress, stage, contract and payments are kept on the project.

objects.title: Audience
objects.summary: An admin creates an audience tag, adds recipients and tags projects.

objects.title: Snapshot
objects.summary: At each recipient's delivery time the worker stores a snapshot with a content hash.

objects.title: Render
objects.summary: Text in core, PNG from the Rust renderer, both watermarked.

objects.title: Read
objects.summary: The recipient signs in to read it, or an admin shares an expiring link.

objects.title: Connect
objects.summary: The agent's client opens the OAuth flow at /mcp.

objects.title: Role cap
objects.summary: An admin approves scopes, never above their own role in that organization.

objects.title: Token
objects.summary: The token is tied to one agent member, with grants per organization.

objects.title: Call
objects.summary: Each tool call runs as that member through the same rules as a person.

objects.title: Record
objects.summary: The call is logged and the write is audited.

objects.title: A change appears on another screen
Write
objects.summary: REST or MCP calls core inside one transaction.

objects.title: Core
objects.summary: The mutation helper applies the rule and the version check.

objects.title: Audit
objects.summary: A trigger writes the activity row and sends a notification with ids only.

objects.title: Socket
objects.summary: The API forwards it to that organization's open browsers, which refetch what changed.

questions.title: Structure
questions.ask: What is it made of, and what is it part of?

questions.title: Responsibility
questions.ask: Who takes part, and who answers for it?

questions.title: Time
questions.gap: The model holds which things carry time. Actual dates live in the running product, not in this model.

questions.title: Resource
questions.ask: What does it take: code, data, entry points?

questions.title: Dependency
questions.ask: What does it need, and what needs it?

questions.title: Value and proof
questions.ask: Why does it exist, and how do we know it works?
questions.gap: Requirements are mapped. Tests are not yet linked to requirements, so proof is not shown.
